scope: Four actual user-supplied versions read in full, with source-linked body sentences and synthetic rewrite templates. Three CCR studies and one Cell Metabolism study; original STK11 highlight membership and its 15-paper sentence resource remain separate.
verification: Source sentences visually checked by each reader. Mechanical normalized literal matching recorded separately; nonmatches do not silently become literal matches. Synthetic templates accept user facts only.

papers.title: Role of KEAP1/NFE2L2 Mutations in the Chemotherapeutic Response of Patients with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
papers.boundary: Pathway-mutant union is not a triple-mutant group; clinical matched association and murine deletion causality are separate. TTF is not PFS; source Table2 HR/CI/P inconsistencies must not be reused as verified adjusted estimates.

papers.title: Baseline Plasma Tumor Mutation Burden Predicts Response to Pembrolizumab-based Therapy in Patients with Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
papers.boundary: Four-gene negative-predictor union is not a four-gene co-mutant genotype or independently validated gene-specific treatment predictor. Endpoint-optimized pTMB cutoff is cohort/assay specific; OS P=.061 and mutation-only comparisons remain nonsignificant.

papers.title: Efficacy and Biomarker Analysis of Camrelizumab in Combination with Apatinib in Patients with Advanced Nonsquamous NSCLC Previously Treated with Chemotherapy
papers.boundary: STK11/KEAP1-mutant means either-gene union, not confirmed double mutation. Single-arm small subgroup and a 12-month OS landmark signal do not establish overall OS benefit, a randomized treatment interaction or reversal of STK11-mediated resistance.

papers.title: Glutaminase inhibition impairs CD8 T cell activation in STK11-/Lkb1-deficient lung cancer
papers.boundary: Engineered genotype comparisons and external human expression associations are separate. Flow V-beta repertoire and tSNE are not TCR-seq or scRNA-seq. Combination impairs immune function under the tested schedule; combination OS was not evaluated.
